WITH per_scope AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT
  acctscope,
  avg_net_fee_rate,
  fee_record_count,
  avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_scope_average
FROM per_scope;

assumptions.assumption: The plain average of the per-scope averages gives each scope with at least one non-NULL net fee rate equal weight; scopes whose net rate is entirely NULL are excluded because AVG ignores NULL values.
